shortDescription: British cancer drug developer Ellipses Pharma on Wednesday said it was exploring a London listing through a deal with  special purpose acquisition company Wolfram Resources LSE:WFR.

children: British cancer drug developer Ellipses Pharma on Wednesday said it was exploring a London listing through a deal with  special purpose acquisition company Wolfram Resources
Established in 2017, Ellipses Pharma's pipeline includes trials for drugs to treat non-small cell lung cancer and breast cancer
The company plans to list its shares on the London bourse following a reverse takeover by shell company Wolfram Resources, whose terms are yet to be agreed
The floatation will provide a much-needed boost to the UK's market which has seen an exodus from companies eyeing higher valuations in markets like the United States
Ellipses Pharma said it is targeting completing the transaction by early 2027
The firm also expects an equity fundraise in conjunction with the deal
Listing through a reverse takeover process will enable the company to raise additional capital from public company investors, founder and chair Chris Evans said
